title: Marguerite and the Archive
author: Jonah Vasquez
blurb: Felix Quintana, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
